name: Impersonators
text: On Recruit and Round Start: choose a rival's member. Until you choose again, this member has its ability.

name: Creditors
text: Game End: each rival loses 1 follower per 3 silver they hold.

name: Kidnappers
text: On Recruit and Round Start: steal the cheapest member of the rival with the most members.

name: Godparents
text: On Use, once per game: give one of your members to a rival. Gain followers equal to its cost.
